prompt: a pad that sounds like light through deep water

recipes.name: Caustics
recipes.why: Light rippling on a sandy floor: one warm saw, the filter opened and closed by a slow drifting LFO, a swelling attack and a deep room.

recipes.name: Pressure
recipes.why: The weight of the water: dark and wide, a sub octave under a detuned unison stack, a slow phaser like the surface far above, and a tail that will not end.

recipes.name: Shafts
recipes.why: Shafts of light cutting down: an open filter singing near resonance, the wavetable frame turning slowly so the colour glints, chorus for the shimmer, a soft entry.
